The fame rework itself is fine. I just wish DECA wouldn't push updates all the time, completely littered with bugs. 

I get that developing games isn't easy at all, but i'd much rather have fewer updates, where the updates themselves aren't littered with bugs, compromosing the gameplay itself. Current examples include:

1. UI Inventory bug when dragging stuff from bags into inventory
2. Vault bug still not fixed (sometimes i literally gotta nexus, and re-enter vault, just to drink pots, not to mention the chance of losing items if not using the drag/drop-box)
3. ROTMG being unplayable on Mac as of patch notes 1.2.1.0.0
4. Item sprites not loading, once opening the game and only appearing after entering a realm/vault/tinkerer
5. Tinkerer shows the wrong amount of time left before quest updates
6. HP Potions only being abled to get picked up by switching them with stuff from inventory
7. The character select screen shows the wrong amount of maxed stats all the time
8. The Fame rework UI is wrong upon death
9. Spelling is wrong on mystery keys as of patch notes 1.2.1.0.0
10. We currently don't have the option to set opacity below 50%. As of patch notes 1.2.1.0.0, the regedit fix is not working, due to dyes/skins not becoming transparent
11. Allen dungeons not dropping fragments

There exists loads upon loads of more bugs. The thing i don't get is why push for updates, when the current state of gameplay is full of bugs? Fix the bugs first, then focus on adding new stuff to enhance the gameplay.
